rules: NO generic full-screen gradients. NO teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4).
Use Flat Solid surfaces. Do NOT use Glassmorphism for this data-heavy app to prevent visual refraction of data.
Use Tinted Greys, no pure #000000 (except for text/deep contrast) or pure #808080.
Never use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays.
DO NOT use Inter, Space Grotesk, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato for headings.
Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headers.
Weight contrast: Use Radical weight contrast (e.g., ExtraBold vs Regular).
Optimized for numbers and dense data.
Left-align paragraphs, inputs, and dense content.

dashboard_grid.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6
rules: F-pattern hierarchy: Place the most critical KPI (e.g., Today's Sales) in the top-left.
Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children to match neighbors.
Grid items MUST be direct children of grid containers.

navigation.desktop: Collapsible Left Sidebar. Avoid crowded top nav. Fixed positioning, z-50.
navigation.mobile: Bottom Navigation (Dashboard, Billing, Inventory, Purchases, More). Fixed bottom, z-50.

spacing.philosophy: Functional density. Use tight gaps for data (gap-2, gap-4) and generous padding for distinct sections (p-6, p-8).
spacing.containers: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding to prevent text collision.

general_rules: Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them.
Do NOT use generic HTML tags like <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn Dropdown, Select, and Calendar.
Cards: Cardless or max 8px border-radius (rounded-md or rounded-none). Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default.
Tables: Use dense data tables for POS/Inventory with sticky headers and hover states. Fast scannability is priority.

buttons.style: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast.
buttons.states: ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-blue-800 hover:text-white). Focus states must have HIGHER contrast.

icons.usage_rules: Use for dense dashboards. Do NOT use AI emoji characters.

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Minimalist and snappy. Focus on micro-interactions for feedback.
rules: Use specific transitions: `transition: transform 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease`.
Hover states must be clearly visible (shift background hue, elevate slightly: -translate-y-[1px] shadow-sm).

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Text below 18px needs 4.5:1 ratio. Large text needs 3:1.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` in kebab-case format (e.g., `data-testid="pos-checkout-button"`).

rules: Use icons or specific curated images for empty states.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a data-heavy ERP/POS system. Prioritize information clarity, fast keyboard navigation for billing, and functional density.
Set up Tailwind variables for the primary color (Klein Blue #002FA7), success (Green #10B981), and danger (Red #EF4444).
Install and import Phosphor icons for all navigational and action icons.
Build the dashboard using the Bento/High-Density grid layout provided. Top-left card MUST be the primary KPI.
Do not center-align dense text or dashboard containers. Always left-align.
Include an explicit 'data-testid' for every single button, link, and input.
Use Shadcn tables for Inventory and POS. Ensure there are active, hover, and disabled states.
